title: Emerald Dreams
description: Emerald Dreams turns Minecraft’s diamond ores and tools into vibrant emerald green, giving your world a fresh, stylish look. Perfect for players who prefer green, making mining and crafting feel fancier than ever!
body: Emerald Dreams transforms Minecraft’s classic diamond ores and tools into vibrant emerald green, giving your world a fresh, stylish look. Perfect for players who prefer green over blue, this pack makes mining and crafting feel fancier while keeping your favorite tools shining beautifully.
